exposure: exclusive breastfeeding in the first six months after birth
cohort: 573 children with asthma (cases) and 812 children without asthma (controls)
finding: Cesarean section without medical indication was associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma, but this risk was attenuated in children who were exclusively breastfed for the first six months after birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section without medical indication was associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma, but exclusive breastfeeding in infancy may attenuate this risk.
